entities.summary: Angelina Chogo Wapakhabulo is a Ugandan social worker and diplomat. She was Uganda's High Commissioner to Kenya. She is a founding member and co-chair of the United Way Board. Wapakhabulo is a community activist and a social worker. Angelina Wapakhabulo was a political leaders from Tanzania (b. 1949-05-24, Tanzania). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
